values.note: Campsites are dry. Only the four group pavilions have power (Pavilion 1 20-amp; 2-4 20 and 30-amp); a camping unit hooked up to water or electric there pays an amenities fee, but may fill its tanks and disconnect free.

hookups.source: https://www.thesilosmt.camp/reserve ('Our Rustic Sites, both Single and Double, are dry camping (no water no hook-ups)', 'All of our Pavilions have electricity - Pavilion 1 has 20 amp service; Pavilions 2, 3 & 4 have 20 & 30 amp service') + https://www.thesilosmt.camp/winter-season ('There is an amenities fee for any Camping Unit hooked up to water and/or electrical. Camping Units may fill their tanks and disconnect without incurring a fee'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Sites 1-86 in five loops (Falcon 1-10, Golden Eagle 11-20, Hawk 21-44, Osprey 45-59, Peregrine 60-86): 75 single sites (one camping unit; 3 of them tent-only) and 11 doubles (two units).

sites.source: https://www.thesilosmt.camp/ (loop descriptions: 'sites 1-10; 8 single sites and 2 double sites', 'sites 11-20 ... All sites in this loop are single sites', 'sites 21-44 ... 19 of the sites are single and 5 of the sites are double', 'sites 45-59 ... 9 single sites and 6 double sites', 'sites 60-86. There are 24 singles sites; 3 of which are tent only and 3 double sites'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Water near Pavilions 1-3 and a tank fill, mid-April to mid-October only; no water or trash pickup October 15 - April 15, when the outhouses are cleaned weekly. Boat launch $6/day or $50/season.

facilities.source: https://www.thesilosmt.camp/reserve ('There is water available near Pavilions 1, 2 & 3') + https://www.thesilosmt.camp/winter-season ('During this time there will be no water or trash collection available in the campground. The outhouses will be cleaned once a week'; 'Camping Units may fill their tanks') + https://www.thesilosmt.camp/ ('Daily Pass: $6', 'Seasonal Pass: $50'), read 2026-10-22

summary: Operator pages re-read: confirmed dry sites (no hookups), 86 sites in five loops, water in season, outhouses, $16/$13 single-site rates, Campspot online booking with a 14-day maximum and the year-round season (all recorded 2026-10-13, left). Changed: hookups/sites/facilities from derived to the operator's pages; added vault toilets and the site breakdown.
flags: Ownership class: the Silos Recreation Area is Bureau of Reclamation land at Canyon Ferry Reservoir, run under a concession; Reclamation's Canyon Ferry page currently posts an 'Extended Bidding Opportunity for Concessionaire Operator at Canyon Ferry's Silos Recreation Area' (https://www.usbr.gov/gp/mtao/canyonferry/index.html). The entry is 'private'; by the concession-on-federal-land rule it should be 'federal' (Reclamation). The concession being re-bid also means the operator, website and booking platform may change for 2027.
